title: Kokomo | Gulf Front 30A Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Kokomo is a Gulf-front 30A home with a private beach, wraparound porches, panoramic views, bikes, and spacious luxury for the whole family.
description_expanded: Kokomo Features - Gulf Front home with private beach to the waterline - Complimentary Use of 6 Beach Chairs and 3 Umbrellas by 30A Shades for reservations March - October - Gulf Facing deck and balconies with lots of Adirondack seating - Outdoor dining on Gulf facing porch - Wrap around porch - goes 360 degrees around the home! - Panoramic Gulf views from almost every room in the house - Access to 4 Taxi bikes, serviced regularly so they are ready for your 30A adventures - 3 min bike ride to Greenway Station, with lots of shopping and dining including Turbo Coffee, Local Cantina, Free People, and the Salty Butcher 30A - 150 yards to Eastern Lake, one of the rare coastal lakes that flows into the Gulf. You can walk there on the sand in minutes. - Fire pit with rocking chair seating in the front yard - Outdoor gas grill - Driveway Parking for 4-5 cars - Cable and WIFI throughout the home - Full kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances from Bosch and Samsung - Dining for 10 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 with panoramic Gulf Views - TVs in all bedrooms plus large smart TV, Blu-ray player and Bose Sound System in the living room - Pack and Play available in Guest Room - Laundry room with washer and dryer on the first floor - 1st Floor Powder Room - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, additional bike rentals, and more - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Let me take you down to Kokomo! Gulf front home with private beach was decorated by our professional design team. Spacious floor plan with a large living area flowing into a dining area and full kitchen - all with incredible Panoramic Gulf Views! All luxury bedding with sleeping for 13 in four bedrooms, including 3 king suites. This home is in a quiet Seagrove neighborhood with a spacious beach front location. Avoid the crowds while still being close to shopping and dining on 30A! Kokomo is a quick 4-minute bike ride to Old Florida Fish House and Buddy's Fish Market, or a 3 min bike ride to Greenway Station with Turbo Coffee, Local Cantina, Free People, and more shopping and dining options. Kokomo features a 360 degree wrap around Gulf facing porch and a Gulf facing balcony with lots of seating, including an outdoor dining table under an umbrella. Your family may never want to leave!

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
